prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Extend `add` with optional `--due YYYY-MM-DD` validation and add a `due` command requiring `--on-or-before YYYY-MM-DD`, with optional `--include-completed` and `--json`. The report must exclude tasks without due dates, default to pending tasks, sort by due date then numeric ID, and label items before the supplied date as overdue without depending on the machine clock. Existing stored tasks without a due date must remain compatible. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/due.txt` and integrate it so non-JSON due reports display the banner before results, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `DUE`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

+function ConvertFrom-TaskForgeDate {
+    param(
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Value,
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$OptionName
+    )
+
+    $parsed = [datetime]::MinValue
+    $valid = [datetime]::TryParseExact(
+        $Value,
+        'yyyy-MM-dd',
+        [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture,
+        [System.Globalization.DateTimeStyles]::None,
+        [ref]$parsed
+    )
+    if (-not $valid) {
+        throw "$OptionName must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format."
+    }
+
+    return $parsed
+}

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$dueDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'due-tasks.json'
$assetPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/due.txt'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    $invalidDue = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Invalid date', '--due', '2026-02-30', '--data-file', $dueDataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidDue.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $invalidDue.Output.Contains('YYYY-MM-DD')) 'add should reject an invalid due date'

    $dueOne = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Boundary task', '--due', '2026-02-01', '--data-file', $dueDataFile, '--json')
    $withoutDue = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Undated task', '--data-file', $dueDataFile, '--json')
    $dueThree = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Earlier pending', '--due', '2026-01-31', '--data-file', $dueDataFile, '--json')
    $dueFour = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Earlier completed', '--due', '2026-01-31', '--data-file', $dueDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True (@($dueOne, $withoutDue, $dueThree, $dueFour | Where-Object ExitCode -ne 0).Count -eq 0) 'due-date fixture tasks should be added'
    $completeDue = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '4', '--data-file', $dueDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($completeDue.ExitCode -eq 0) 'due-date fixture task should be completed'

    $dueDefault = Invoke-TaskForge @('due', '--on-or-before', '2026-02-01', '--data-file', $dueDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($dueDefault.ExitCode -eq 0) 'due report should succeed'
    $defaultReport = @($dueDefault.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True (($defaultReport.id -join ',') -eq '3,1') 'due report should exclude undated and completed tasks and sort by due date then numeric ID'
    Assert-True ($defaultReport[0].overdue -eq $true -and $defaultReport[1].overdue -eq $false) 'due report should determine overdue status from the supplied date'
    Assert-True (-not $dueDefault.Output.Contains('DUE_DATE_TASK_01_INFO')) 'JSON due report should not contain the banner'

    $dueAll = Invoke-TaskForge @('due', '--on-or-before', '2026-02-01', '--include-completed', '--data-file', $dueDataFile, '--json')
    $allReport = @($dueAll.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True (($allReport.id -join ',') -eq '3,4,1') 'due report should include completed tasks on request and retain numeric ID tie-breaking'

    $dueText = Invoke-TaskForge @('due', '--on-or-before', '2026-02-01', '--data-file', $dueDataFile)
    $banner = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($assetPath).TrimEnd("`n")
    Assert-True ($dueText.Output.StartsWith("$banner`n")) 'text due report should display the banner before results'
    Assert-True ($dueText.Output.Contains('[overdue] #3 2026-01-31 Earlier pending')) 'text due report should label overdue tasks'

    $missingBoundary = Invoke-TaskForge @('due', '--data-file', $dueDataFile)
    $invalidBoundary = Invoke-TaskForge @('due', '--on-or-before', 'not-a-date', '--data-file', $dueDataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingBoundary.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $invalidBoundary.ExitCode -ne 0) 'due report should require a valid --on-or-before date'

    $legacyDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'legacy-tasks.json'
    '[{"id":7,"title":"Legacy","description":"","status":"pending","createdAt":"2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"}]' | Set-Content -LiteralPath $legacyDataFile
    $legacyDue = Invoke-TaskForge @('due', '--on-or-before', '2026-02-01', '--data-file', $legacyDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($legacyDue.ExitCode -eq 0 -and @($legacyDue.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 0) 'due report should accept stored tasks without due dates'

    $assetText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($assetPath)
    $assetLines = @($assetText.TrimEnd("`n") -split "`n")
    Assert-True ($assetText.EndsWith("`n") -and -not $assetText.EndsWith("`n`n")) 'banner should end with exactly one newline'
    Assert-True ($assetLines.Count -eq 12) 'banner should contain exactly 12 lines'
    Assert-True (-not @($assetLines | Where-Object { $_.Length -lt 20 -or $_.Length -gt 48 }).Count) 'banner lines should be 20-48 characters'
    Assert-True (-not @($assetLines | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^[A-Z0-9 +|/\\_*.#():=-]+$' -or $_ -match '\s$' }).Count) 'banner should contain only allowed ASCII characters without trailing whitespace'
    Assert-True ($assetText.Contains('DUE')) 'banner should contain DUE'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: 25 fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
